about: Lays an application out: bars across the top and the bottom, and a body between them holding a panel down either side of the page.

divided.about: A hairline on the inner edge of each bar and each panel, beside a shell with none.
divided.title: Divided

scroll.about: The page scrolling inside a shell the height of the window, and the document growing under bars that stick.
scroll.title: Scroll

title: App shell

variant.about: Every look. Plain sets the page against the ground; inset raises the page as a card on a muted ground; floating raises the contents of each panel instead.
variant.title: Looks
